newsitem.title: UK: Inquiry dwindles on sugar freight market.
newsitem.headline: Inquiry dwindles on sugar freight market.

text.p: Business calmed down on the sugar freight market on Tuesday after the spate of activity seen at the start of the week with only a limited number of orders cited, shipbrokers said.
E D & F Man quoted for 4,500 tonnes of bagged sugar from Motril to Mersin for prompt dates.
It was open for a further 6,000 tonnes from Santander to the Turkish Mediterranean for November/December dates.
Universal Bulk Carriers issued an account order for 14,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Continent to south Iran for the first half of December.
The only reported fixture of the day came from Lorico, said to have fixed 10,000 tonnes of bagged sugar into Egypt for early December dates.
Elsewhere, Zimbabwe tendered to buy 28,000 tonnes of raw sugar for arrival in two shipments in January and February.
Trade sources said various shipments options were possible but the initial requirement was for two 14,000-tonne cargoes to arrive for January 6/11 and February 3/8.
